# Agora: instructions for GitHub Copilot

Read `AGENTS.md` in the root of this repo before changing anything. Its rules win over everything else in this repo.

The short version:
- This is Agora (7 Billion Presidents), a copy of Hylo. Our repo is `Guyvk/agora`, main branch `agora`.
- Never open, comment on or push anything to `Hylozoic/hylo`.
- One branch per job, draft pull requests with base `agora`. Never merge, never push to `agora`, never force-push.
- No passwords, keys, tokens or real people's data anywhere. Demo data only.
- Mark changes to Hylo's own files with an `Agora:` comment and list them in `AGORA-CHANGES.md`.
- Every change comes with a test. Pull requests in plain words, no em dashes.
